saw_lines: Lifters don’t follow a brand for the clothes. They follow it for the people wearing them.
So every drop lives or dies on the creators and the clips, not the product shots.
Seven channels from Discord to TikTok, and every drop has to land on all of them. One creator story per drop, cut for each channel.
ads_1: Performance creative for every drop, women and men
soc_1: Brand social strategy across TikTok, Instagram and Discord
